text:
rachel-partnerships: Quick preflight for marketplace listings — focus: GCP K8s deploy (Marketplace Container) + Azure SaaS offer. Need final plan IDs, deployment artifacts, and legal checks before we request test accounts.

omar-cloud: I'm on GCP manifest review. Two questions: do we publish as a Container VM or as a Helm chart? Helm gives customers easier upgrades.

rachel-partnerships: Prefer Helm for flexibility. But we still need a container URI and a minimal deployment/values example for the listing docs.

felix-eng: We'll provide both: container image + Helm chart tar.gz. Chart naming: redwood-inference-chart-2.3.0.tgz. Sample values.yaml below.

```yaml
image:
  repository: gcr.io/redwood-inference/inference-runtime
  tag: prod-v2
service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 8080
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: "500m"
    memory: "1Gi"
  limits:
    cpu: "2"
    memory: "4Gi"
```

omar-cloud: For the GCP listing we also need a support contact and SLA text. Sam, can marketing provide the 1-line support blurb we put in the marketplace tile?

sam-marketing: Yep. Draft: "Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference with configurable dedicated pools and 99.9% SLA for reserved capacity." Will send a 40-word expanded line later today.

nina-legal: Legal items: EU DPA checkbox must be explicit. Also confirm export-control scan on the image layers (no restricted crypto). If any 3rd-party binaries with special licenses are present, list them.

felix-eng: Running a layer scan now. FYI we include a bundled OpenBLAS binary (BSD-like) and a quantized kernel compiled from our repo. No OpenSSL variants beyond stock distro.

ops-bot: Automated note: GCP Marketplace vendor onboarding window for partner sandbox closes 2026-07-10. Request sandbox access by 2026-07-03 to guarantee review. :warning: 

rachel-partnerships: Azure-specific: they require a SaaS offer plan id mapping and a screenshot of the provisioning blade. We don't have the blade screenshot yet. Felix, can you capture the provisioning UI from the test tenant?

felix-eng: Yes — I'll spin up a test provisioning flow and take the screenshots. ETA tomorrow AM. Also adding a minimal ARM template snippet for the listing docs.

```json
{
  "type": "Microsoft.Resources/deployments",
  "apiVersion": "2021-04-01",
  "properties": {
    "mode": "Incremental",
    "template": {
      "$schema": "https://schema.management.azure.com/schemas/2019-04-01/deploymentTemplate.json#",
      "resources": []
    }
  }
}
```

nina-legal: For Azure contracts we need to reconcile two items: the marketplace SaaS reseller fee language and our standard data liability clause. I'll post redlines in the shared doc by EOD Fri.

omar-cloud: Pricing mapping: proposal is three plans: dev (flat monthly, 500 reqs/day), team (metered tokens + monthly baseline), enterprise (reserved GPU nodes + SLAs). Need SKU ids for each cloud catalog. Ben (not on thread) usually generates the SKU format; we should keep consistent naming across clouds.

rachel-partnerships: Good point — consistent SKU pattern: RWI-<CLOUD>-<PLAN>-<VERSION>. Keep VERSION = v2026-07.

sam-marketing: Also we need one hero screenshot and an architecture diagram (PNG). I'll coordinate with design for a simple diagram showing routing to hosted/dedicated/private.

felix-eng: Small technical blocker: Helm chart currently packages the KV cache as an optional feature that requires a redis endpoint. Marketplace deploys won't provide that by default. We should document recommended post-deploy steps for enabling cache (example values override).

rachel-partnerships: Call out in docs: "Redis optional: customers can provide external Redis or enable managed cache add-on". Also include billing note if customers choose managed cache (may change metered costs).

nina-legal: Action: I'll verify DPA language and export-scan result by Fri. If the image scan flags anything, I'll escalate.

felix-eng: Action: upload chart + container URI + provisioning screenshots by TOMORROW 10:00 PT.

omar-cloud: Action: publish draft marketplace manifest (GCP + Azure) to share drive by MON. Will include SKU mapping per pattern.

sam-marketing: Action: hero screenshot + 40-word blurb + diagram by EOD today.

ops-bot: Reminder sent to #partnerships: please attach artifacts to the vendor-onboarding folder.

rachel-partnerships: If anyone needs an extension, flag here. Otherwise I'll create a combined PR for the listing repo once we have the artifacts. Thanks — will follow up with a checklist doc. :white_check_mark:
